chamfer_capture — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.chamfer_capture(kp, eps0: 'float') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.chamfer_capture(kp, eps0: 'float') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("chamfer_capture"))

Usage

Whether the chamfer can absorb an initial lateral offset ε₀ [m] without correction: |ε₀| ≤ W + c_r (condition for the tip edge to land on the chamfer surface; derived).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り: captured、eps_max = W + c_r、margin = eps_max − |ε₀|。既定の寸法では 1.2 mm。傾き θ₀ があると先端の縁の投影が動くが、θ₀ ≤ 3° では無視できる(試作の格子で ε₀ = 2, 3 mm が補正なしで失敗した根拠)。
